info.title: MojoTxt Universal API
info.description: Send texts, manage subscribers, and track donations and lists

post.description: Creates a donation keyword in MojoTxt.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

fundName.description: Fund name for the donation keyword. MojoTxt currently defaults this when omitted, despite the docs marking it required.

keyword.description: The unique keyword for the donation fund.

phoneNumber.description: The MojoTxt phone number in international format, like +17792533748.

recurringScheduleId.description: Default recurring schedule: 0 one-time, 1 weekly, 2 bi-weekly, 3 monthly, or empty to ask the user.

thankYou.description: Thank-you message sent after a successful donation.

timestamp.description: MojoTxt server timestamp for the response.
